targetTexts.1: A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
targetTexts.2: For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”
targetTexts.3: You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:
targetTexts.4: ‘I will establish your offspring forever and build up your throne for all generations.’” Selah
targetTexts.5: The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD—Your faithfulness as well—in the assembly of the holy ones.
targetTexts.6: For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
targetTexts.7: In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.
targetTexts.8: O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.
targetTexts.9: You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.
targetTexts.10: You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
targetTexts.11: The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.
targetTexts.12: North and south You created; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.
targetTexts.13: Mighty is Your arm; strong is Your hand. Your right hand is exalted.
targetTexts.14: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.
targetTexts.15: Blessed are those who know the joyful sound, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.
targetTexts.16: They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they exult.
targetTexts.17: For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.
targetTexts.18: Surely our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
targetTexts.19: You once spoke in a vision; to Your godly ones You said, “I have bestowed help on a warrior; I have exalted one chosen from the people.
targetTexts.20: I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.
targetTexts.21: My hand will sustain him; surely My arm will strengthen him.
targetTexts.22: No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.
targetTexts.23: I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.
targetTexts.24: My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him, and through My name his horn will be exalted.
targetTexts.25: I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.
targetTexts.26: He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’
targetTexts.27: I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
targetTexts.28: I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.
targetTexts.29: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.
targetTexts.30: If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments,
targetTexts.31: if they violate My statutes and fail to keep My commandments,
targetTexts.32: I will attend to their transgression with the rod, and to their iniquity with stripes.
targetTexts.33: But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.
targetTexts.34: I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips.
targetTexts.35: Once and for all I have sworn by My holiness—I will not lie to David—
targetTexts.36: his offspring shall endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun,
targetTexts.37: like the moon, established forever, a faithful witness in the sky.” Selah
targetTexts.38: Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him; You are enraged by Your anointed one.
targetTexts.39: You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust.
targetTexts.40: You have broken down all his walls; You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.
targetTexts.41: All who pass by plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
targetTexts.42: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; You have made all his enemies rejoice.
targetTexts.43: You have bent the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle.
targetTexts.44: You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
targetTexts.45: You have cut short the days of his youth; You have covered him with shame. Selah
targetTexts.46: How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
targetTexts.47: Remember the briefness of my lifespan! For what futility You have created all men!
targetTexts.48: What man can live and never see death? Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
targetTexts.49: Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old, which You faithfully swore to David?
targetTexts.50: Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants, which I bear in my heart from so many people—
targetTexts.51: how Your enemies have taunted, O LORD, and have mocked every step of Your anointed one!
targetTexts.52: Blessed be the LORD forever! Amen and amen.
